next_step: SE deep-dive to reproduce prompt parity issues + Dedicated pricing proposal by 2026-03-17
notes:
Company snapshot: mid-market B2B SaaS that embeds an AI assistant in product onboarding and in-app help. Currently on provider X (vendor-prop API) but cost and lack of deployment flexibility are driving exploration of Redwood Hosted -> Dedicated migration. 

Recent timeline (bullets):
- 2026-02-15: Intro discovery call (Jordan / Priya) — product scope, current infra, rough ARR bucket. Customer said: "need predictable token economics, and ability to isolate sensitive flows."
- 2026-02-23: Hosted API demo — focused on streaming chat, embeddings quality, and rollout controls. Attendees: Head of Product, Lead ML Eng, Infra Eng. Positive reaction to routing/fallbacks.
- 2026-03-02: POC kickoff (2-week) — migrate three flows: onboarding chat, KB embeddings for search, inline reranking for search results. Fireflies: ff-2026-03-02-0123 (linked).
- 2026-03-05: POC milestone 1 — basic integration complete, latency ~80-150ms on Hosted for small prompts, embeddings throughput 250 qps with batching.
- 2026-03-08: Tokenization mismatch discovered during prompt parity tests; ~8% of chat responses differ stylistically vs incumbent. Logged INF-3421.
- 2026-03-09: Regression triage call — customer flagged two high-risk prompts that hallucinate product pricing. SE suggested prompt normalization and temp changes as stopgap.

Use-case & requirements summary:
- Workloads: primary = interactive chat for onboarding (multi-turn), secondary = semantic search via embeddings, tertiary = reranking for SERP quality.
- Latency SLOs: p95 request latency <300ms for chat (aiming for ~150ms average on Dedicated).
- Throughput: expect sustained 40-60 QPS for embeddings during peak indexing; chat concurrency ~120 concurrent sessions.
- Cost sensitivity: mid-market finance org expects <=2x current per-token cost during evaluation; Dedicated reserved commit must show clear unit-econ improvements. Quoted: "we can tolerate small hits if SLA & regressions managed."
- Model preferences: prefer using a mixed-strategy — higher-capacity model for chat, quantized smaller model for embeddings/rerank. Need model variants + fallback routing.
- Migration concerns:
  * Compat layer: customer has ~30 service-side prompts and a server-side orchestration layer tied to incumbent API semantics. Wants minimal code changes — looking for a compatibility shim or SDK parity.
  * Prompt parity & regressions: primary blocker — customers observed stylistic drift on 2/30 prompts and one hallucination that fails acceptance. Need an evaluation harness to detect regressions pre-cutover.
  * Tokenization differences: affects token counts and cost estimates; POC shows ~6-9% token delta on typical prompts.

POC notes / technical actions taken so far:
- Baseline extraction: exported 30 representative prompts + expected ground-truth snippets from their test harness.
- Compatibility shim: SE built quick adapter mapping existing API fields to Redwood Hosted calls; still missing subtle behaviors around streaming deltas and function-calling edge cases.
- Regression detection: ran side-by-side A/B on 5k queries; flagged 134 statistical differences, narrowed to 3 high-risk regressions for product flows.
- Mitigations attempted: small prompt edits, temperature seed adjustments, and switching to a nearby model variant. Partial success: 2 regressions resolved, 1 persistent hallucination remains.

Commercial / Procurement notes:
- Pricing ask: provide Dedicated reserved capacity options (monthly commit tiers) with clear per-token math vs hosted. Need an example 12-month commit showing breakeven vs incumbent.
- Contract items: DPA, data residency clause (US + EU region routing), SOC2 attestation required for procurement.
- Stakeholders: Head of Product (decision), VP Eng (technical ok), Legal (DPA & residency), Finance (cost review).

Next steps (explicit):
1) SE deep-dive (Priya) scheduled 2026-03-15: reproduce remaining hallucination in isolated harness + proposed prompt modifications.
2) Redwood to deliver Dedicated pricing worksheet & 12-month commit scenarios by 2026-03-17.
3) Legal to get initial DPA draft; customer to confirm residency language (EU routing) by 2026-03-24.

Sales notes / shorthand:
- Win criteria: demonstrable prompt parity (no regressions on 30-critical prompts), >=25% cost improvement on token economics with Dedicated, and SOC2 + residency assurances.
- Risk: moderate — technical regressions are solvable but need SE bandwidth + possible model tweaks. Procurement timeline ~May if POC closes cleanly.
- Quote from customer: "We like Redwood's routing and rollback controls — but we can't afford a step-back in conversational quality."

Linked artifacts: pricing deck (drive), POC runbook, regression report (INF-3421).
